description: This Java source file defines a final class 'RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' which is a builder for creating responses related to retrieving feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing response objects and handling errors, utilizing a nested ResponseFactory class.
